result.Method of Attack: Malware spread via phishing emails impersonating Taiwan's National Taxation Bureau; malware embedded in password-protected ZIP files distributed via phishing; use of side-loading DLLs to execute encrypted shellcode; anti-VM checks, privilege escalation, installation of persistent malware; Remote Access Trojan (RAT) functionality with C2 communication for data collection, module download, and remote control; use of multiple shellcode loaders and payload modules including remote desktop and file manager
result.Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious attachments or links; password-protected ZIP files downloaded from phishing emails or webpages; side-loading of DLLs by legitimate executables; exploitation of user privilege escalation and anti-VM evasion techniques
